about: The Wikipedia articles the Wikipedia feed tracks (wikipedia/run.mjs), and which of this site's sources asked for each. Agents ask for a new article by adding it here (or asking data.d@), not by reading Wikipedia themselves: one shared copy keeps our traffic to Wikimedia small. Titles are English Wikipedia's.
